subject.title: docs(troubleshooting): add recovery runbook for plugin install metadata conflict after update

question: Should OpenClaw support retiring a conflicting legacy `installs.json` after registry inspection, and if so which authoritative checks or Doctor command make that recovery safe?
rationale: The code and user-facing repair contract determine whether preserving the SQLite record and archiving the legacy file is safe across the broader conflict/state-drift cases; this cannot be inferred from one successful installation.

options.title: Define a supported convergence command
options.body: Add or identify an idempotent Doctor/plugin-registry repair path, then document that command and its verification criteria.

options.title: Narrow to observed diagnostics only
options.body: Keep the new section limited to symptom collection and escalation, without instructing users to rename persisted migration input.

options.title: Accept the manual runbook
options.body: Explicitly endorse the documented registry checks and in-place archival as the supported recovery contract for this conflict class.

recommendation.title: Define a supported convergence command
recommendation.body: Add or identify an idempotent Doctor/plugin-registry repair path, then document that command and its verification criteria.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision belongs to the current owner of plugin state migration and Doctor recovery behavior.
